The compact variant is particularly useful when the space in the first fold is limited. For example on product listing pages.

| **Requirements** in addition to the default settings for the background color of the image, users can change the color afterwards the user can change the background color of the nodes The "see more" variant functions as a button/link to the supercategory / listing page.  Consequently, it should be possible to specify either a category ID or a URL. this creates freedom for the creativity of our customers. Storybook stories have been created:

Please make sure to put these images into `packages/ui/playground/.storybook/public/category-node/`

## Technical details

I believe the see-more variant is always the same colors as the default variant. Therefore there is no separate see-more. They only distinguish themselves by content.

All states (default, hover, active, focus) are implemented correctly.

The variant of the CategoryNode decides which flag-corners to use. The corners of the flag-prop must be ignored.

longDescription:
## Purpose

The CategoryNodeCompact component provides a space-efficient category navigation element designed for areas with limited viewport space, such as product listing pages and compact navigation sections. It offers extensive styling flexibility while maintaining a small footprint.

## Use Cases

- Display subcategory navigation on product listing pages
- Create compact category grids in sidebar or filter areas
- Show text-only category links when images are not needed
- Highlight sale categories with dedicated red or branded sale variants
- Add promotional badges like "Sale", "New", or custom flags
- Link to supercategory pages via the see more pattern

## Design Rationale

The compact variant prioritizes space efficiency while maintaining visual appeal through multiple design options. The optional image feature allows flexibility for text-focused layouts. Eight variant combinations cover common use cases from subtle outlines to bold sale highlights. Flag corner positioning is automatically determined by the node variant to ensure visual consistency.
shortDescription: Used in Inpage Navigation Compact Grid and Slider components. Supports customizable background colors per node and 1:1 aspect ratio images. See more variant links to supercategory pages via category ID or URL. Themed component with multiple color modes for light, dark, and bright backgrounds. Icon display available via LuiIcon integration.
